categories.name: p2p
categories.evidence: Has the P2P label and configures low-level TCP socket options for peer connections.
categories.rationale: Configuring `SO_OOBINLINE` resolves cross-platform socket polling divergences where `select()` repeatedly flags unread TCP urgent data as pending. Because PR #36665 already prevented this condition from stalling or crashing the node, this fix is a worthwhile hardening improvement across non-Linux platforms rather than an urgent critical issue.
